description:
## Mandatory context and boundaries
Read the parent epic first. Applicable owners: AGENTS.md; docs/agent-tools.md; docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md; docs/action-reuse.md; docs/testing-approach.md; docs/services/channels.md (communication/Jido bridge and provider contracts); docs/services/engine.md (history, admission, finalization and delivery). Read docs/documentation.md before documentation/skill edits, docs/services/system-config.md before credential fixtures, and local module @moduledoc before extending a helper. Apply code-quality for code and skill-creator for the skill.
Only test/ additions or backward-compatible support changes, lib/mix/tasks/zaq.test.gen.channel.ex, and .agents/skills/add-channel-integration-tests/** are authorized. Do not edit application modules, dependency source/pins, config, migrations, mix.exs, CI, or unrelated skills. Existing-test expectation changes require the testing handbook's explicit approval; this epic authorizes additive coverage, not changing expectations.
Use real bridges, NodeRouter, Engine admission/history/persistence and configured Agent execution. Only provider/LLM boundaries are faked. A production defect is a reported blocker with a reproducer; do not patch production, silently omit a scenario, weaken an assertion, or close the issue as complete.
Validation timing, failure handling and final gates are owned by docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Record executed commands/results in this issue. No new browser E2E is needed: this work adds test/developer infrastructure without changing a deployed UI journey. No commit/push/merge authorization is implied.

Parent epic: zaq-o9d

## Functional specification and scope
This issue starts only after the preceding implementation-review issue records actual approval. Apply the repository's coverage-upper workflow to final changed code as required by docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md and the available skill; keep numerical coverage gates in this phase. Tests/support helpers and the developer Mix task must be classified using the tool's actual report, not assumed covered/excluded.
Fix reachable missing cases only within the allowed test/tooling paths and without changing production behaviour or existing assertions. Review any coverage-driven change before finalization. Record justified uncovered/unreachable/tooling exclusions with concrete evidence instead of weakening checks.
After all required work/review/coverage is complete, run the final validation gate exactly as prescribed by docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md before asking for final human approval. No implementation step or passing partial test run substitutes for this gate.

## Tests and branches
Maintain passing full matrix for all registered drivers, generator tests and affected existing helper/provider consumers. Cover real uncovered error/validation branches such as invalid callback outputs, registry consistency, script operation matching, generator preflight/rollback and cleanup where the coverage report shows a meaningful gap. Avoid tests that mirror private implementation or only increase a number.
Validation commands/lifecycle, Context Mode timeouts and repeat/failure rules are authoritative in docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; do not copy stale procedure versions here. Report blocked tools/environment honestly.

## Mocking plan
External provider/LLM only for runtime cases; isolated temp files/adapters for developer task tests. No new internal application mocks or production test seams.

## Documentation and final evidence
Record final revision/diff basis, scope audit (including untracked files), per-provider/scenario results, configured providers lacking drivers, generator dry-run/write checks, skill validation, coverage outcome/exceptions, and final precommit result.
Explicitly verify no changes under lib/zaq/**, lib/zaq_web/**, deps/**, config/**, migrations, mix.exs, mix.lock or CI. Only the named Mix task and repository skill are permitted outside test/.
No new browser E2E is required: this epic changes test/developer infrastructure only. Run existing regressions required by the workflow; do not create an artificial UX approval/E2E dependency.

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse completed harness, provider fakes, tests and validation tools. Coverage/test additions are local-only test code; documentation of evidence adds no domain Action. Preserve all prior reuse/default guarantees.

## Done when
Required coverage work and review are complete, final mix precommit passes on the final changes, scope audit is clean, and the human gives final approval with evidence recorded here. Do not close the epic while this issue or any required child is unfinished. Do not commit/push/merge solely because approval of this plan or epic exists.
title: [zaq-o9d.12] Complete post-review coverage handoff, final validation and human approval
